projects.name: Tessera
description: Tessera is a residential development that quietly redefines what modern urban living can feel like. Developed by Al Ghurair Development and designed by the renowned Portuguese architect Manuel Aires Mateus — marking his first residential project in the UAE — Tessera introduces a low-density building concept that delivers the privacy, space, and ease typically associated with townhouse communities. Located in Dubai South's Residential District, this is not just a place to live; it is a considered environment where architecture, landscape, and daily life come together with intention and care.

Dubai South is one of the emirate's most strategically positioned and rapidly evolving urban destinations. Spanning 145 square kilometres, it was conceived as a self-contained city and is home to the Al Maktoum International Airport — set to become one of the world's largest aviation hubs. The Residential District within Dubai South offers a quieter, community-oriented setting away from the intensity of the city centre, yet with full access to Dubai's wider infrastructure.

Every unit at Tessera reflects the architectural philosophy of Manuel Aires Mateus, where space is treated not as a luxury but as a necessity. The layouts are crafted to feel open and liveable, with clear distinctions between private and social areas of the home.

What sets Tessera apart architecturally is the deliberate restraint and precision that Manuel Aires Mateus brings to the project. Known internationally for work that emphasises volume, light, and material honesty, Aires Mateus has translated his signature sensibility into a residential context that feels grounded and genuine. The building avoids visual excess in favour of clean geometry, considered proportions, and a material palette that ages well. The result is a structure that feels both permanent and refined — architecture that respects its residents rather than performing for them.

The design philosophy behind The Weave draws directly from the intricate patterns of traditional palm weaving. Layered, interlacing balconies bring this inspiration to life, giving the façade depth, movement, and a visual identity that stands out within the neighbourhood.

projects.name: Skycrest Collection

projects.name: Sorrento
description: Sorrento at Damac Lagoons is a thoughtfully designed residential development that draws its spirit from the sunlit coastal towns of southern Italy. Every element of Sorrento — from its warm architectural palette to its tranquil surroundings — is designed for those who value refined living without the noise of excess.

Damac Lagoons is one of Dubai's most visually striking residential addresses, and Sorrento occupies a prized position within it. Surrounded by crystal-clear lagoons, lush green spaces, and a network of thoughtfully planned community zones, the location offers a sense of retreat without sacrificing access to the wider city. The development sits within a master-planned environment that prioritizes open space, water features, and a human-centered approach to design.

This central positioning means that whether you are commuting to work, heading out for leisure, or accessing international schools and healthcare facilities, Sorrento keeps everything within a practical and stress-free distance.

Sorrento offers a curated selection of residential units designed to accommodate a range of lifestyles, from individuals seeking a serene retreat to families looking for space and community. projects.name: Tahiti

projects.name: Violet 4 Phase 3

Situated along the bustling Sheikh Zayed Road, Volta enjoys a strategic location amidst Dubai's tallest hotels and iconic attractions. Courtyard One sits within the Residential District of Dubai South, a thoughtfully zoned area that balances peaceful everyday living with access to the broader energy and convenience of the wider development zone.

What sets Courtyard One apart from conventional apartment developments is its emphasis on spatial harmony and deliberate design. The central open-air courtyard acts as the social and visual core of the project, drawing natural light deep into the building while creating a shared community space that encourages interaction. Facades are crafted with clean lines and a contemporary aesthetic, while private terraces on select units extend the living space outward.

Dubai South has attracted significant attention from investors over recent years, and for good reason. The district's long-term development roadmap, anchored by Al Maktoum International Airport's expansion into one of the world's largest aviation hubs, positions the area for sustained demand growth in both sales and rental markets. Apartments in well-designed boutique developments like Courtyard One tend to hold value well and attract quality tenants — particularly professionals linked to the aviation, logistics, and events sectors that are central to Dubai South's economy.

projects.name: Golden Woods Albab Views
description: Golden Woods Albab Views offers a premium residential experience in the heart of Dubai South. This boutique development combines sophisticated design with modern functionality, providing a serene retreat while maintaining seamless access to Dubai's key destinations. Rising as a ground-plus-four-storey structure, the freehold development features studio, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments, each crafted to deliver a refined lifestyle.

Strategically positioned in Dubai South (Dubai World Central), Golden Woods Albab Views benefits from one of Dubai’s most rapidly developing districts. Residents enjoy excellent connectivity to business hubs, entertainment, and transport networks, making it ideal for professionals and families alike.
This location ensures residents enjoy both peace and convenience, with urban amenities just minutes away.
Golden Woods Albab Views reflects contemporary architectural excellence. The ground-plus-four-storey configuration creates an intimate community atmosphere while optimizing space and natural light.

projects.name: Lateral One
description: Lateral One stands as a testament to thoughtful urban planning and sophisticated residential design within Dubai's prestigious Dubai Land Residential Complex. Developed by the renowned Grand Signature Development and conceptualized by Aqua Properties, this exceptional residential project represents a harmonious blend of modern architecture, practical functionality, and refined lifestyle amenities. The development embodies a contemporary residential philosophy where every element has been carefully curated to meet the evolving needs of today's discerning residents.

This meticulously planned community offers an impressive selection of studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments, including premium two-bedroom units with dedicated maid's rooms. With unit sizes ranging from efficient 440 square feet studios to expansive 2,750 square feet residences, Lateral One caters to diverse lifestyle requirements, from young professionals seeking their first home to growing families requiring spacious living environments.

Strategically positioned within Dubai Land Residential Complex, Lateral One benefits from one of Dubai's most sought-after residential neighborhoods. This prime location offers residents the perfect balance between serene suburban living and urban accessibility, making it an ideal choice for those who value both tranquility and connectivity.

Lateral One showcases contemporary architectural excellence through its clean structural lines and well-defined forms that create a striking visual presence within the community. The building's façade harmoniously integrates with the surrounding environment while maintaining its distinctive character.

projects.name: Meriden Beach
description: Set along the pristine coastline of Dubai Islands, Meriden Beach by Green Horizon Development offers an exceptional blend of island calm and Dubai’s urban energy. Its beachfront placement delivers direct access to soft sands and clear waters while maintaining smooth connectivity to prominent business and leisure destinations.

Meriden Beach features contemporary architecture enriched with tropical influences that celebrate its coastal surroundings. The design focuses on maximizing natural light, openness, and seamless transitions between indoor and outdoor spaces.
The project includes 63 residences: 28 one-bedroom units, 33 two-bedroom units, and 2 three-bedroom penthouses, each oriented to capture scenic island vistas.
Meriden Beach provides resort-style comforts that elevate everyday routines, offering a serene, exclusive environment shaped around wellness and leisure.

projects.name: 77 Shades
projects.developer: 77 Shades of Green Real Estate Development
description: 77 Shades, located in Dubai's Business Bay, is an innovative residential project by Green Real Estate Development L.L.C. Combining modern architecture, sustainable design, and luxurious living, it is set to redefine urban living. The development offers an array of exclusive features and is positioned to become one of Dubai’s most prestigious addresses.
Adjacent to a public park, the development offers views of the Water Canal and Burj Khalifa.
Each unit includes high-end finishes, smart home technology, and energy-efficient systems.
77 Shades is scheduled for completion by July 1, 2027. The development is progressing as planned, with regular updates for stakeholders.

projects.name: Joya Mimosa Residences
description: Introducing Joya Mimosa Residences, a luxurious 25-story residential skyscraper developed by Green Yard Properties. This stunning property offers modern and contemporary luxury apartments in the vibrant heart of Dubai Sports City, making it a beacon of beauty and grace in the skyline.

Joya Mimosa Residences offers a diverse range of apartment types to cater to various interests and needs. While detailed information about the number of bedrooms, square footage, and pricing is currently not available, the development promises high-quality living spaces.

Joya Mimosa Residences by Green Yard Properties is an exciting new development in Dubai Sports City, offering luxurious apartments in an excellent location. With its modern design, strategic positioning, and a wide array of amenities, residents can expect an exceptional living environment. Whether you seek a comfortable home or a solid investment opportunity, Joya Mimosa Residences stands out as a prime choice.

projects.name: Greenfield Living
description: Located in the heart of Dubai South's thriving residential district, Greenfield Living offers a fresh take on premium apartment living. Developed by Greenfield Real Estate Development, this contemporary community presents a carefully curated collection of 1- and 2-bedroom apartments designed to merge sleek, modern aesthetics with practical, everyday comfort.

Every home is crafted to be more than just visually appealing—it’s built to enhance the way residents live. Neutral, stylish interiors, combined with premium finishes and thoughtful design touches, create spaces that feel both inviting and refined. Greenfield Living emphasizes warmth and functionality, making each apartment a true sanctuary for residents.

Situated within Dubai World Central, Greenfield Living enjoys a strategic position in one of Dubai's fastest-growing districts. This master-planned community is designed for convenience, connectivity, and a sustainable lifestyle, offering residents a harmonious blend of tranquility and urban access.
With such connectivity, residents can enjoy a peaceful home environment while remaining just minutes from Dubai’s key business, leisure, and cultural centers.

projects.name: Aris
description: Aris is a new residential development by Grid Realty, thoughtfully designed for those who value comfort, practicality, and a well-connected lifestyle. Located in the heart of Dubai South, Aris offers a curated selection of studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments that strike the right balance between refined design and everyday functionality. Each unit reflects a clear understanding of how people actually want to live — with enough space to breathe, layouts that make sense, and finishes that feel considered rather than excessive.

Dubai South is one of the emirate's most ambitious master-planned communities, and for good reason. Covering a vast area around Al Maktoum International Airport, it has been designed from the ground up to support a full residential ecosystem — with schools, retail, parks, and employment hubs all woven into its fabric. The Dubai South Residential District, where Aris is situated, is among the most livable pockets of this growing community.

Residents of Aris benefit from excellent road connectivity that links them to the wider city with minimal effort. The development sits close to two of Dubai's most important arterial routes, making daily commutes and weekend outings equally straightforward.

Aris caters to a diverse range of buyers and renters, from young professionals looking for a smart first home to small families seeking a comfortable, well-sized apartment. The available unit types reflect a pragmatic approach to modern urban living.

projects.name: Enchante
description: Enchante is a contemporary residential development by Grid Properties, offering thoughtfully designed studio, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments in one of Dubai's most promising communities — Arjan. This off-plan project brings together modern architecture, quality finishes, and practical living spaces to create a home that feels both refined and genuinely comfortable.

Arjan is a fast-growing residential district in the heart of Dubailand, steadily gaining recognition as one of Dubai's most livable and investment-friendly communities. The area offers a balanced urban environment with a mix of residential towers, green spaces, and easy access to retail and dining options. Enchante sits within this thriving district, giving residents the benefit of a well-established neighborhood atmosphere while still being part of Dubai's dynamic growth story.
One of Arjan's strongest advantages is its central positioning within Dubai's road network, offering straightforward access to major destinations across the city.
The area's connectivity via Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Umm Suqeim Road ensures that residents are never far from Dubai's key business, retail, and leisure destinations.

projects.name: Eterna
description: Eterna By Grid is expected to launch with a flexible payment plan with the affordability of Dubai Production City. You would begin with a modest down payment to reserve your unit, then settle the remaining balance through manageable installments across the construction period until handover. A staged structure of this kind allows you to acquire an apartment here without any monthly pressure, while your capital remains available for other commitments. As Grid has yet to publish the final terms, the exact payment split and milestones remain to be confirmed.

projects.name: Valore
description: Valore is a modern residential development by Grid Properties, situated in one of Dubai's most sought-after communities — Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC). Designed to reflect the demands of contemporary urban life, the project brings together thoughtfully crafted apartments, refined interiors, and a well-rounded selection of lifestyle amenities. Whether you are a first-time buyer, a growing family, or a property investor looking for a smart entry into Dubai's residential market, Valore presents a compelling opportunity in a community that continues to grow in both appeal and value.

The development offers studio, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, each designed with functional layouts and modern finishes that prioritize comfort without sacrificing style. With prices starting from AED 699,888, Valore positions itself as an accessible yet quality-driven choice for those looking to own property in a vibrant Dubai neighborhood.

Jumeirah Village Circle has steadily earned its reputation as one of Dubai's most livable and well-connected residential communities. Valore takes full advantage of this address, placing residents within a green, family-friendly environment that balances the energy of the city with a quieter, more relaxed pace of life. JVC is recognized for its parks, wide streets, and community-oriented atmosphere — qualities that make it especially appealing for those seeking a genuine sense of neighborhood in a fast-paced metropolitan city.
The location also benefits from ongoing infrastructure development and consistent demand from both tenants and buyers, making it a strategically sound address for long-term property ownership.

projects.name: Coral Isle
description: Located in the center of the Dubai Islands, Coral Isle is a prominent residential property by Grovy Real Estate Developers. Coral Isle offers a distinctive lifestyle characterized by design, creativity, and sustainability by fusing modern architectural brilliance with the tranquility of the seaside. In Dubai's most ambitious coastal destination, it blends eco-friendly design, smart living solutions, and expansive sea views to create a haven for luxury seekers. Coral Isle is a landmark destination in the visionary Dubai Islands, offering residents a vibrant mix of privacy, convenience, and luxury. With architecture inspired by the ocean’s curves and interiors shaped for comfort and flexibility, this development is tailored to diverse modern lifestyles. Situated within the dynamic Dubai Islands, Coral Isle places residents in one of the city’s most promising waterfront districts. This location merges the tranquility of beachside living with quick access to urban hotspots.
Dubai Islands is envisioned as a global lifestyle and tourism hub, and Coral Isle ensures residents are at the center of this transformative development.

projects.name: Ramada Residences by Wyndham

projects.name: Rivo by Grovy

Standing in one of Dubai’s most evolving communities, Rivo allows residents to enjoy relaxed suburban living without giving up access to the city’s dynamic urban offerings.

The tower presents a modern residential option in one of Dubai's growing mid-market communities, making it an appealing choice for both end-users and investors looking for consistent value.

Positioned within Al Warsan 4 — one of Dubai's established and steadily developing residential zones — Sadaat Tower benefits from a location that balances urban access with a quieter neighborhood feel. Al Warsan 4 is a freehold area that has attracted a diverse community of residents, making it a culturally vibrant and socially active place to call home. Its residential character, combined with growing infrastructure and proximity to major Dubai corridors, makes it an area with genuine long-term appeal.

Al Warsan 4 is well-positioned within Dubai's broader road network, offering residents practical access to the city's key destinations. Sadaat Tower's location means that daily commuting and weekend exploration are both equally manageable.

projects.name: Olaia Residences

Spacious apartments with floor-to-ceiling windows, smart home technology, and high-end finishes, designed for the ultimate luxury living experience.

projects.name: Tonino Lamborghini Phase 2

Eeden House Za'abeel accommodates households of various sizes, offering thoughtfully designed units and community-driven spaces that promote a nurturing atmosphere.

projects.name: Edra Villas
description: Edra Villas is a premium residential development by H&H Real Estate Developers, set within the expansive wellness-focused master community of The Heights Country Club & Wellness in Dubai. Designed for those who value space, privacy, and a refined quality of life, Edra Villas offers a curated collection of four, five, and six-bedroom villas that bring together thoughtful architecture and generous living areas in one of Dubai's most promising residential corridors.

Positioned within The Heights Country Club & Wellness, Edra Villas enjoys the advantage of being part of a master community built around wellness, open green space, and low-density living. The wider development spans a remarkable scale, integrating parks, landscaped corridors, nature trails, and wellness amenities that shape the character of the entire neighbourhood. Living here means stepping into an environment designed not just for shelter, but for a healthier, more balanced way of life.

Direct access to Emirates Road (E611) makes commuting straightforward, whether heading toward the city centre or toward Dubai South's growing business and aviation hub. This strategic positioning adds significant practical value to everyday life at Edra Villas.

Each configuration is designed to maximise internal space and flow, ensuring that families have room to live comfortably across generous floor plans. From intimate family gatherings to entertaining guests, every villa size at Edra offers the square footage to support a full and active home life.

projects.name: Maia Villas
description: Maia Villas is a standalone villa community developed by H&H Real Estate Developers, set within Eden Hills — one of the most thoughtfully planned sub-communities inside Mohammed Bin Rashid City, Dubai. Unlike high-rise or mixed-use developments, Maia Villas is entirely focused on spacious residential living, offering five-bedroom villas designed for families who want genuine space, privacy, and a strong sense of community without sacrificing proximity to the city's core.

Eden Hills occupies a distinctive position within Mohammed Bin Rashid City, one of Dubai's most ambitious and expansive master-planned developments. Sitting between Downtown Dubai and the Dubai–Al Ain Road corridor, MBR City has become one of the most sought-after destinations for villa and townhouse buyers over the past several years.

Maia Villas offers a single, focused product: generously scaled five-bedroom standalone villas. This deliberate approach allows H&H Real Estate Developers to concentrate design quality, construction standards, and landscaping across a consistent villa type rather than spreading resources across multiple formats. The five-bedroom configuration is particularly well-suited to larger families or those who want dedicated space for guests, a home office, or a private gym setup within the residence itself.

Maia Villas takes a considered architectural approach that prioritises livability over visual excess. The villas are designed around natural light, open internal flow, and a relationship between indoor and outdoor space that suits the Dubai climate. Wide plot sizes allow for private garden areas, and the overall architectural language reflects a clean, contemporary aesthetic that ages well and appeals to a broad range of buyers. The emphasis throughout is on quality of finish and spatial generosity rather than decorative statement-making.

projects.name: Peninsula Dubai Residences - Tower 1
description: Peninsula Dubai Residences - Tower 1, developed by H&H Development, offers a stunning array of luxury apartments in the prestigious Jumeirah 2 area. Designed to cater to discerning tastes, the project embodies contemporary elegance, world-class amenities, and an unbeatable location.

Nestled in Jumeirah 2, Peninsula Dubai Residences - Tower 1 provides seamless access to Sheikh Zayed Road, pristine beaches, and top attractions such as the Dubai Mall and Mall of the Emirates. Surrounded by lush green spaces, it offers the perfect balance of tranquility and urban convenience.

Residents enjoy state-of-the-art fitness centers, swimming pools, spa facilities, and landscaped jogging tracks. The development also features dedicated entertainment spaces, including cinemas, game rooms, and outdoor barbecue areas, ensuring a holistic living experience.

The development offers a mix of thoughtfully designed apartments, from cozy studios to expansive penthouses, catering to diverse lifestyle needs. Each unit is crafted with high-quality materials, premium finishes, and smart home integrations.

projects.name: Peninsula Dubai Residences Tower 2
description: Peninsula Dubai Residences Tower 2 by H&H Development is a refined residential address that brings together thoughtful architecture and elevated living in one of Dubai's most established neighbourhoods. Rising gracefully in Jumeirah 2, this tower is designed for those who seek comfort, space, and a connection to the vibrant pulse of Dubai — without compromising on quality or sophistication.

Each residence reflects a careful balance between contemporary design and everyday practicality. From compact studios to expansive multi-bedroom apartments, every unit is crafted with precision, integrating clean lines, premium finishes, and generous proportions that make daily living feel genuinely elevated.

Jumeirah 2 is one of Dubai's most coveted residential addresses — a leafy, low-density neighbourhood that combines a relaxed coastal character with convenient access to the city's key destinations. Peninsula Dubai Residences Tower 2 sits at the heart of this community, placing residents within reach of the beach, boutique dining, and cultural landmarks that define modern Dubai living.

The area is known for its tree-lined streets, family-friendly environment, and a strong sense of community — qualities that make it particularly attractive for families, professionals, and long-term residents who value both lifestyle and location.

projects.name: Rosewood Residences
description: Rosewood Residences Dubai is a distinguished branded residential development positioned along the waterfront at Peninsula, Jumeirah 2 — one of Dubai's most coveted coastal addresses. Conceived for those who expect more from where they live, this limited-collection development brings together the legacy of Rosewood's celebrated hospitality philosophy and the refined sensibility of contemporary architecture.

Each residence is carefully considered in its layout, materiality, and orientation, with panoramic water views, premium finishes, and generous proportions defining the experience from the moment you step inside. Whether you are seeking a permanent home or a prestige address in Dubai, Rosewood Residences sets a compelling benchmark for what branded living can be.

Situated in Jumeirah 2, one of the most established and desirable residential corridors in the emirate, Rosewood Residences occupies a rare waterfront position that balances the energy of the city with the calm of the coast. Jumeirah 2 is a neighborhood defined by wide tree-lined streets, proximity to the Arabian Gulf, and a strong sense of community — qualities that attract both long-term residents and international buyers.

The address places residents within easy reach of Jumeirah's beach clubs, boutique dining, and cultural landmarks, while offering the kind of serene, low-density environment that is increasingly rare in Dubai. This is a location that carries genuine prestige without the congestion of more commercially dense districts.

projects.name: Glass Haus Residences
description: Glass Haus Residences is a thoughtfully conceived low-rise residential development rising six storeys in the heart of JVT District 2, Dubai. Developed by Hausen Developments, this project reflects a clear design philosophy: create homes that feel genuinely liveable, not just visually impressive. The building's modest scale is a deliberate choice — one that prioritises a quieter, more grounded residential experience while keeping residents within easy reach of Dubai's vibrant urban core.

The apartments inside are shaped by a modern urban sensibility that doesn't sacrifice comfort for style. Efficient floor plans allow natural light to move freely through living spaces, and every interior detail is chosen with daily practicality in mind. Quality finishes, clean proportions, and well-considered layouts make these homes equally well-suited to working professionals and growing families seeking a place that genuinely feels like home.

Jumeirah Village Triangle is one of Dubai's most consistently popular residential communities, and for good reason. Its tree-lined streets, low-rise character, and strong sense of neighbourhood make it a preferred address for families and professionals alike. Glass Haus Residences sits within District 2 of JVT, a section of the community known for its calm atmosphere and convenient access to the broader city.

The location strikes a balance that many Dubai residents actively seek — enough distance from the intensity of downtown life to feel peaceful at home, yet close enough to key business districts, shopping destinations, and entertainment hubs to remain fully connected. It's a setting that supports a well-rounded lifestyle without demanding compromise.

projects.name: Haus 99 Residences
description: Haus 99 Residences at Jumeirah Village Triangle (JVT) is an exciting off-plan residential development by Hausen Developments, offering a selection of modern apartments and townhouses in one of Dubai’s growing residential communities. Designed to provide a comfortable and contemporary lifestyle, the project presents an attractive opportunity for homebuyers and property investors seeking a well-connected location in Dubai.

The development features a diverse range of residential options, including studio, 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom units, catering to individuals, couples, and families with different lifestyle needs. Haus 99 aims to combine modern residential living with the convenience of an established neighborhood.

Located in Jumeirah Village Triangle (JVT), residents can enjoy a peaceful community atmosphere with convenient access to major roads, shopping destinations, schools, parks, and essential amenities. The strategic location makes Haus 99 an appealing choice for those looking for a balance between urban connectivity and relaxed residential living.

The architecture draws inspiration from ocean waves, reflecting elegance and fluidity, while interiors feature high-end finishes and smart technologies. Residents enjoy direct access to community parks, stunning sea views, and a tranquil environment away from the city’s bustle, making it a perfect oasis in the heart of Dubai.

Located within Island A of Dubai Islands, Isolana Residences offers residents an unmatched balance of privacy and connectivity. Its strategic position ensures easy highway connections and proximity to cultural hubs, golf courses, and luxury resorts. The peaceful island ambiance combined with easy access to major city attractions makes Isolana Residences a prime location for both living and investment.
All units feature high-end finishes, smart home technologies, and private balconies or terraces with spectacular views.

Isolana Residences is a strong investment, blending luxury island living with easy urban access. This development represents a unique opportunity for buyers seeking an exclusive waterfront residence in Dubai’s evolving real estate landscape.

Rising majestically across B+G+3P+15 floors, Park Lane 3 embodies Heilbronn Developers' long-standing commitment to creating homes that feel considered, balanced, and richly detailed.

projects.name: Babylon Tower
description: Babylon Tower by Heritage Development is redefining what it means to live well in Dubai. Rising confidently in the heart of Barsha Heights (TECOM), this striking residential tower offers a curated selection of 1-bedroom, 2-bedroom, and 3-bedroom apartments designed for those who value both comfort and connectivity. More than a place to rest, Babylon Tower is a thoughtfully engineered living environment a genuine safe haven set within one of New Dubai's most dynamic and sought-after districts.

With a design philosophy rooted in what Heritage Development calls "Refined Urbanism," every aspect of this tower has been shaped with intention. The result is a residence that feels both grounded and aspirational, blending the energy of a connected urban hub with the calm of a well-considered home.

Barsha Heights, formerly known as TECOM, occupies a rare position in Dubai's urban landscape it is simultaneously a thriving commercial district and an increasingly popular residential destination. Home to major media companies, tech firms, and creative agencies, the area attracts a diverse community of professionals, entrepreneurs, and families who want to be close to the action without sacrificing quality of life.

Babylon Tower sits at the centre of this energy. Residents benefit from tree-lined streets, retail outlets, dining options, and a neighbourhood that genuinely feels lived-in and vibrant. The proximity to Dubai Internet City, Dubai Media City, and Al Barsha offers a sense of place that many newer developments simply cannot replicate.

projects.name: Wadi Hills
description: Situated in the heart of DubaiLand Residence Complex, Wadi Hills by Hijazi Real Estate redefines modern urban living. This impressive 13-storey tower (B+G+11) houses 140 fully furnished homes designed for residents who value comfort, sophistication, and practicality.

Unit sizes range from 369 to 1,436 square feet, offering studios, 1-bedroom, and 3-bedroom apartments. Each home features floor-to-ceiling windows, open-plan layouts, generous storage solutions, and premium finishes, all starting from AED 712000. Wadi Hills presents an exceptional opportunity to secure a contemporary urban residence in one of Dubai’s most sought-after communities.

Strategically positioned in Wadi Al Safa 5, Wadi Hills balances serene suburban living with seamless urban accessibility. Its location is ideal for families and professionals looking for a well-connected yet tranquil neighborhood.
Residents enjoy a location that offers convenience without compromising on peace and comfort.

projects.name: Double Tree by Hilton
description: This ambitious development by the renowned Hilton brand promises to deliver an unparalleled blend of comfort, luxury, and convenience to Dubai's ever-evolving skyline. With its strategic location, world-class amenities, and the backing of a globally recognized hospitality leader, Double Tree by Hilton is poised to become one of the most sought-after residential addresses in the emirate.

Double Tree by Hilton is a meticulously planned residential complex that offers a range of 1 and 2-bedroom apartments designed to cater to the discerning tastes of modern urban dwellers. The project, currently under construction, is slated for completion in Q2 2027, offering investors and homeowners alike the opportunity to be part of Dubai's exciting future.

Located in the central area of Jumeirah Garden City, Double Tree by Hilton offers residents a perfect blend of vibrant city life and peaceful surroundings. Its proximity to vital infrastructure ensures seamless connectivity, making everyday commuting efficient and stress-free.
Double Tree by Hilton is designed to provide a holistic lifestyle, with amenities curated to offer wellness, recreation, and convenience.

projects.name: J Haus Residences
description: Located in the dynamic Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), J Haus Residences offers a collection of premium apartments designed for modern urban living. The development features thoughtfully planned studio,1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, ideal for individuals, couples, and families seeking a refined lifestyle in one of Dubai’s most sought-after communities.

Each residence boasts open layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows, and high-quality finishes, creating bright and inviting living spaces. projects.name: Beverly Crown

The project is crafted for residents who value thoughtful design, quality finishes, and a lifestyle that balances modern urban living with a genuine sense of calm and community.

From its contemporary architectural language to its carefully curated interiors, Beverly Crown represents a new standard for residential living in JVC — one that prioritizes both aesthetic appeal and everyday practicality. Whether you are looking for your next home or a sound investment in Dubai's ever-evolving real estate market, Beverly Crown delivers on both fronts.

Situated in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle, Beverly Crown benefits from one of Dubai's most strategically positioned and well-established residential districts. JVC has grown steadily into a sought-after address for families, young professionals, and investors, thanks to its lush green spaces, pedestrian-friendly layout, and strong sense of community.

The neighborhood is surrounded by landscaped parks, tree-lined pathways, a wide variety of retail outlets, dining options, healthcare clinics, and reputable schools — everything residents need within close reach. JVC's village-style atmosphere, combined with its central Dubai location, makes Beverly Crown an especially compelling place to call home.

projects.name: Beverly Grande

Whether you’re taking your first step into real estate or seeking a more spacious home, this development provides a unique opportunity to enjoy premium living in a highly sought-after location.

The development benefits from Motor City’s reputation as a master-planned community that blends residential comfort with commercial convenience. Upcoming metro connectivity will further enhance accessibility, making it a smart choice for end-users and investors alike.

projects.name: Beverly Park

Beverly Park offers a variety of amenities that cater to residents of all ages, creating a vibrant and engaging community environment.
Beverly Park encourages a strong sense of community while respecting personal privacy, creating a family-friendly environment where residents can flourish.

projects.name: The Promise Villas
description: Located in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle, The Promise Villas offers a revolutionary take on premium residential living in Dubai. Developed by HNB Vision, this exclusive collection of 18 contemporary villas redefines the concept of “architectural hospitality,” transforming homes into serene sanctuaries that blend elegance, comfort, and functionality.

Each villa spans up to 3,398 square feet and features four bedrooms, thoughtfully designed to accommodate a variety of family lifestyles. From the moment you enter, you’ll notice the seamless combination of natural light, refined textures, and advanced functionality, creating private retreats that invite relaxation and connection.
Situated in one of Dubai’s most desirable neighborhoods, The Promise Villas enjoys a perfect balance of calm suburban living and seamless urban connectivity.
Residents benefit from a peaceful, family-friendly environment while remaining just minutes from Dubai’s major business and leisure hubs.

projects.name: Holm 3
description: Holm 3 by HOLM Development introduces a refined residential offering within the evolving Jumeirah Garden City district in Dubai's Al Satwa neighborhood. This mid-rise development delivers a balanced approach to modern urban living, prioritizing functional layouts, efficient use of space, and long-term value retention. Designed for residents who appreciate both proximity to Dubai's commercial core and the comfort of a low-density residential environment, Holm 3 presents studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments that cater to diverse lifestyle preferences and investment objectives.

The development emphasizes clean architectural lines and thoughtful interior planning, creating homes that accommodate both owner-occupiers and tenants seeking quality accommodation in a well-connected location. With prices starting from AED 1.14 million, Holm 3 positions itself as an accessible entry point into Dubai's freehold residential market within an established neighborhood undergoing continued enhancement and infrastructure development.

Holm 3 occupies a strategic position within Jumeirah Garden City, an address that bridges the energy of central Dubai with the tranquility of established residential neighborhoods. Al Satwa's ongoing transformation into a modern residential hub has attracted attention from residents and investors alike, drawn by its central location and improving infrastructure. The development sits close to Sheikh Zayed Road, providing residents with immediate access to Dubai's primary arterial route while maintaining the calm atmosphere of a residential enclave.

The surrounding area benefits from a mix of retail conveniences, dining venues, educational facilities, and healthcare services, creating a self-sufficient community where daily needs are within easy reach. This location appeals particularly to professionals working in Business Bay, DIFC, and Dubai Media City, as well as families seeking quality housing without the isolation of distant master-planned communities.

projects.name: Holm One

Holm One is crafted with modern architectural finesse, emphasizing light, space, and elegance.
Holm One combines comfort and convenience to create a lifestyle-focused living experience.

Holm Central occupies a prime position within this evolving area, placing residents within easy reach of the city's most dynamic commercial, retail, and leisure destinations.

This location is ideal for professionals, families, and investors who want the energy of central Dubai without sacrificing the comfort of a well-planned residential community. The surrounding streetscape is walkable, vibrant, and continuously improving as Jumeirah Garden City matures into a fully integrated urban destination.

projects.name: Celeste

projects.name: Sakura Gardens

The façade blends traditional craftsmanship cues with modern engineering and sustainability features suited to Dubai’s contemporary lifestyle.

projects.name: Skyhills Astra

All units feature floor-to-ceiling windows, designer kitchens, high-end finishes, and smart home

Skyhills Astra is more than a home—it's a visionary community blending luxury, innovation, and social impact. With its strategic location, world-class amenities, and commitment to sustainability, this development sets a new benchmark for modern living in Dubai.

projects.name: The Borough

Nestled along Jumeirah's pristine coastline at La Mer, Solaya 4 and 6 offer residents an unparalleled opportunity to experience direct beach access while maintaining seamless connectivity to Dubai's vibrant urban landscape.

These architectural marvels feature thoughtfully designed residences ranging from spacious 3 to 5-bedroom apartments to spectacular penthouses, each meticulously planned to maximize breathtaking sea, city, and beach views. With generous ceiling heights, open-plan layouts, and seamless indoor-outdoor living spaces, every residence embodies the essence of modern coastal luxury.

Solaya 4 and 6 occupy one of Dubai's most coveted addresses within the prestigious La Mer development. This prime beachfront location offers residents the rare privilege of waking up to panoramic ocean views while being just minutes away from Dubai's key destinations and business districts.

The location perfectly balances the tranquility of beachfront living with the convenience of urban connectivity, making it ideal for families seeking a sophisticated lifestyle without compromising on accessibility to Dubai's commercial and cultural hubs.

projects.name: Solaya 5 and 7
description: Nestled within the prestigious Port De La Mer development, Solaya 5 and 7 by Meraas Holding represents the pinnacle of waterfront luxury living in Dubai. This exclusive off-plan development seamlessly blends Mediterranean-inspired architecture with contemporary Dubai sophistication, offering discerning residents an unparalleled coastal lifestyle.

The development embodies the perfect harmony between tranquil beachfront living and urban connectivity, making it an ideal choice for families, professionals, and investors seeking a premium residential experience in one of Dubai's most coveted locations.

Solaya 5 and 7 enjoys an enviable position within Dubai's prestigious Jumeirah district, specifically in the La Mer area of Solaya - La Mer. This strategic location offers residents the rare opportunity to experience authentic beachfront living while maintaining easy access to Dubai's business and entertainment hubs.
The location provides the perfect balance between serenity and accessibility, offering residents a resort-like lifestyle within the dynamic city of Dubai.

projects.name: Solaya 8
description: Solaya 8 is a nine-storey residential building that forms part of the exclusive Solaya at La Mer development by Meraas Holding in Dubai. With approximately 27 carefully curated residences, this limited-edition building offers a rare opportunity to own a home within one of the most sought-after coastal communities in the emirate. The architectural vision behind Solaya 8 was entrusted to Foster + Partners, the globally acclaimed design studio known for creating spaces that balance elegance with functionality.

Solaya 8 sits within La Mer, Jumeirah 1 — a beachfront destination that has matured into one of Dubai's most vibrant and liveable coastal addresses. The wider La Mer community blends open-air dining, leisure, and retail with a relaxed seaside atmosphere, making it a natural draw for residents who want everyday life to feel like a getaway. Within this setting, the Solaya sub-community creates a quieter, more residential enclave that offers privacy without sacrificing proximity to everything La Mer has to offer.

The involvement of Foster + Partners in the design of Solaya 8 is one of the project's most distinguishing attributes. The firm, founded by Sir Norman Foster, has shaped some of the most iconic buildings in the world, and their approach to Solaya 8 reflects a commitment to considered, human-centred design. Expect clean lines, thoughtful material choices, and floor plans that maximise natural light and the surrounding coastal views.

Residential properties within La Mer and the broader Jumeirah 1 corridor have demonstrated consistent demand from both end-users and investors, driven by the area's lifestyle credentials and limited land availability. Solaya 8, with its restricted unit count and Foster + Partners pedigree, occupies a compelling niche in this market — it is not a project that can be easily replicated or replaced.

projects.name: Solaya 1,2 and 3
description: Solaya 1,2 and 3 in La Mer is an ultra-luxury residential development by Meraas Holding, offering a seamless fusion of vintage charm and modern design. Located in the prestigious Jumeirah district of Dubai, it promises an exceptional living experience with expansive apartments and world-class amenities. This project represents the pinnacle of coastal living, offering unmatched elegance, tranquility, and convenience.

Solaya 1,2 and 3 by Meraas Holding offers a unique blend of luxury living, stunning design, and prime location, making it the perfect choice for those seeking an extraordinary lifestyle in Dubai. Whether as a residence or an investment, it promises exceptional returns and an unrivaled living experience in the heart of Dubai.

projects.name: The Acres
description: The Acres, a brand-new residential property by Meraas, is situated in The Acres within the esteemed Plantation Equestrian & Polo Club in Dubai. This project features a stunning assortment of stand-alone villas that have been painstakingly created to offer an opulent and refined way of life. The Acres promises an unmatched lifestyle in the green core of Dubai with its emphasis on premium materials and standard amenities.

Situated south of Al Reem and east of Damac Hills and Arabian Ranches, The Acres location is along Emirates Road, near the Autodrome, Sports City, JVC, and Arabian Ranches. Simple access to Dubai's main thoroughfares and important sites, such as commercial centers, retail centers, and entertainment places, makes The Acres an ideal choice for those seeking luxury and convenience.
These amenities ensure that residents at The Acres experience a lifestyle of comfort, leisure, and well-being.

The Acres by Meraas is a lifestyle destination rather than only a housing development. It offers an unmatched living experience in Dubai thanks to its ideal location, unique amenities, and an assortment of roomy housing alternatives. With its well-planned layout, on-site community facilities, and prime location, The Acres is a great choice for families searching for an opulent and cozy residence in the city's green core.

projects.name: The Acres Estates Phase 3 by Meraas
description: The Acres Estates Phase 3 by Meraas is a prestigious villa community in Dubailand, redefining luxury living with its exquisite design, premium finishes, and seamless integration with nature. Developed by Meraas Holding, this phase continues the legacy of The Acres, offering an exclusive residential experience in one of Dubai’s most sought-after locations.
All villas feature expansive living areas, premium finishes, private gardens, and smart home technology.

The Acres Estates Phase 3 is a landmark in luxury villa living, offering spacious residences, top-tier amenities, and an unparalleled lifestyle. With its prime location, architectural excellence, and strong investment potential, this development by Meraas stands as a premier choice for homeowners and investors alike.

projects.name: The Acres Phase 2

Strategically located in Dubailand, The Acres Phase 2 provides seamless connectivity to major roads like Sheikh Zayed Bin Hamdan Al Nahyan Street and Emirates Road. It is just 10 minutes from Global Village, 5 minutes from Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, and near key attractions, ensuring a balance of serenity and accessibility.

The Acres Phase 2 redefines luxury living in Dubailand, offering a serene yet connected lifestyle. With its prime location, exceptional amenities, and elegant residences, it stands as an outstanding investment and a sanctuary for those seeking refined living in Dubai.

projects.name: The edit at D3
description: The Edit at D3 by Meraas Holding redefines premium residential living in Dubai’s most creative neighborhood. This striking development features three sculptural towers where contemporary architecture meets organic, nature-inspired forms. Designed as a lifestyle destination, it offers residents a sophisticated balance between creative energy and waterfront tranquility.

Scheduled for completion in January 2030, The Edit at D3 presents a versatile range of residences, from intimate 1-bedroom apartments to expansive 5-bedroom penthouses. Each home is thoughtfully designed to cater to diverse lifestyle preferences while upholding the highest standards of comfort and quality.

Located at the heart of Dubai Design District (d3), The Edit at D3 offers residents direct waterfront access while keeping them connected to the city’s most prestigious areas. Dubai Mall, Downtown Dubai, and Business Bay are all just minutes away.

Dubai Design District has become a premier hub for international design houses, art galleries, and innovative enterprises. Living at The Edit at D3 places residents within a lively creative ecosystem, providing cultural experiences and networking opportunities that extend well beyond traditional residential living.

projects.name: Verve City Walk
description: With its exceptional location and high-quality construction, Verve City Walk homes are expected to appreciate significantly, presenting a lucrative investment opportunity for buyers.

In summary, Verve City Walk encapsulates luxury living in Dubai, offering a perfect blend of lifestyle, convenience, and modern amenities. Whether you’re looking for a family home or a stylish apartment, Verve City Walk is the ultimate destination for urban coastal living.

projects.name: Warsan First
description: Warsan First by Dugasta is an exciting new development that is sure to make an impact in Dubai's real estate market. This project, located in the thriving neighbourhood of Al Warsan, provides excellent connectivity, a wide range of amenities, and a community-focused living experience. Warsan First is designed to appeal to both investors and homeowners, offering a combination of flexibility, accessibility, and high-quality living.

While specifics about unit types, sizes, and prices are still to be determined, Warsan First promises to provide a variety of options tailored to different needs and preferences. The development will include sub-communities, each with its own set of amenities and services to help residents live better lives.
Warsan First provides a variety of entertainment options in addition to residential living.

Warsan First by Dugasta is an exciting new development in Dubai's thriving real estate market. With its prime location, flexible property options, and extensive amenities, it appeals to both investors and homeowners looking for quality living and growth potential. The project's emphasis on creating a safe, community-oriented environment makes it an excellent choice for both families and individuals alike.

projects.name: Celeste
description: Celeste is a thoughtfully designed residential development by Meraki Developers, located in the heart of Dubai South's Residential District. The project brings together contemporary architecture and practical living to offer a home that suits the pace and ambitions of modern city dwellers. Whether you are looking to settle into a vibrant new community or secure a foothold in one of Dubai's fastest-growing districts, Celeste presents a compelling opportunity to do both.

Dubai South is one of the emirate's most ambitious master-planned communities, covering a vast area designed to integrate residential, commercial, logistics, and lifestyle offerings under one cohesive vision. Positioned as the city's second urban core, this district has steadily grown into a destination in its own right — attracting residents, businesses, and investors who recognise the long-term value of being early in a developing hub.

Celeste has been planned with resident comfort at the forefront. The amenities on offer cover daily wellness, leisure, and security — creating a self-contained living experience that reduces the need to travel far for everyday needs.

Celeste reflects a design philosophy rooted in clarity and purpose. The architecture favours clean lines, functional layouts, and materials selected for both durability and visual appeal. Interiors are conceived to feel open and well-lit, with spatial planning that prioritises how residents actually move through and use their homes. Rather than ornamentation for its own sake, the design leans into quality finishes and cohesive aesthetics — delivering apartments that feel elevated without being overwrought.

projects.name: Nirvana Residence
description: Nirvana Residence stands as a testament to thoughtful urban living in the heart of Dubai Production City (IMPZ), representing Meraki Developers' commitment to creating homes that blend luxury with practicality. This recently launched residential development offers discerning buyers an exceptional opportunity to invest in one of Dubai's most dynamic and fastest-growing business and media districts.

The development caters to diverse lifestyle needs through its carefully curated selection of studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments, each designed with innovative layouts that maximize space efficiency while maintaining the highest standards of comfort and elegance. This thoughtful approach to residential design ensures that whether you're a young professional, growing family, or savvy investor, Nirvana Residence offers the perfect home solution.

Dubai Production City, formerly known as International Media Production Zone (IMPZ), represents one of Dubai's most promising residential and commercial districts. This established area has evolved into a thriving hub that seamlessly combines business excellence with residential tranquility, making it an ideal location for Nirvana Residence.

The district's strategic positioning offers residents unparalleled access to Dubai's major business centers while maintaining a peaceful residential atmosphere. The area is renowned for hosting numerous media companies, publishing houses, and corporate offices, creating a vibrant professional ecosystem that ensures consistent rental demand and property value stability.

projects.name: The Haven Phase 2 By Meraki

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road : Provides direct access to Dubai, Al Ain, Sharjah, and Abu Dhabi.

Discover the perfect blend of luxury, convenience, and community living at The Haven 2. Secure your future in one of Dubai's most promising new developments."

projects.name: The Haven Phase 3 By Meraki Developers

This visionary residential project is designed to redefine urban living in Dubai, offering a harmonious retreat with easy access to the city’s key attractions. Whether for personal use or as an investment opportunity, The Haven Phase 3 represents a forward-thinking approach to urban living in Dubai.

projects.name: Cresswell Homes

Located in the heart of Dubai South, this project brings together modern architecture, functional layouts, and a well-rounded community lifestyle — creating a living environment that feels both refined and genuinely livable.

With bright interiors, large windows that invite natural light, and fully fitted kitchens, every residence at Cresswell Homes has been crafted for everyday comfort without compromise. Whether you are a young professional, a growing family, or a savvy investor, this development delivers a compelling balance of quality, convenience, and long-term value.

Situated within the Residential District of Dubai South — one of the most ambitious and fastest-growing urban destinations in the UAE — Cresswell Homes occupies a strategically chosen address that continues to gain momentum. Dubai South is a master-planned city designed to support a population of nearly one million residents, anchored by Al Maktoum International Airport and the legacy of Expo City Dubai.

The Residential District itself is a peaceful, low-density neighborhood characterized by wide open spaces, lush landscaping, and a calm atmosphere that stands in contrast to the intensity of central Dubai. For residents seeking a quieter pace of life without sacrificing connectivity or opportunity, this location strikes an ideal balance.

projects.name: Iconic Residences
description: Iconic Residences is a 66-storey premium residential tower by Mered Dubai, positioned between Palm Jumeirah and Burj Al Arab. Designed by Pininfarina, the project delivers 310 apartments and one penthouse across a building that places equal weight on aesthetics, technology, and resident comfort. Prices start from AED 3,400,000, with handover scheduled for Q1 2028.

Interiors are finished in wood and marble throughout. Advanced technologies are integrated as standard, including multi-stage air and water purification, enhanced sound insulation, and heated bathroom floors. VIP private parking boxes with air conditioning are provided for residents.

The tower sits in one of Dubai's most sought-after coastal corridors, directly facing Palm Jumeirah. The metro is a one-minute walk away, providing fast connections across the city. Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Marina, and Bluewaters Island are all within minutes by car or public transport.
Leisure options are extensive. Residents have direct access to beaches, five-star hotels, golf clubs, Dubai Harbour, and a well-developed dining and retail scene along the waterfront.

projects.name: Aurum by Meteora
description: Aurum is a rare expression of refined urban living - intelligently positioned, and quietly distinguished. This is a residence for those who choose proximity with privacy, and value with permanence.

Aurum offers rare access without compromise. It’s Dubai at your doorstep, but not at your window. Only moments from Sheikh Zayed Road, and within a 10-minute radius of Dubai’s finest Hospitals, universities, innovation districts, beaches, and three major malls – all within 10 minutes. Yet from within, there is only sheer bliss. That is the true luxury.

Set within one of Dubai’s most intuitively located neighborhoods, Aurum places you in seamless rhythm with the city. One minute to Sheikh Zayed Road. Three minutes to the metro. Five minutes to world-class healthcare and destination shopping. Ten minutes to the beach, and to the ideas and innovation that power Media City and Knowledge Village.
Aurum sits at the intersection of thoughtful design and meaningful placement. A residence where location doesn’t interrupt life, it enhances it.

Park Boulevard has a variety of unit options to meet diverse requirements and interests. Each apartment is intended to optimize space while still providing a comfortable living environment.

Meteora Developers' Park Boulevard is expected to redefine luxury living in JVC, Dubai. With its great location, distinct characteristics, and several housing options, it provides inhabitants with a harmonic balance of contemporary design and urban convenience. Park Boulevard has something for everyone, whether they are single professionals, couples, or families. Park Boulevard is the ultimate of sophistication and comfort, blending luxury with everyday living.

projects.name: Viani by Meteora

Liwan’s thoughtful master planning brings together comfort, accessibility, and urban energy, making it a practical choice for young professionals, families, and investors seeking a well-connected address.

projects.name: Richmond District

Located in the heart of Al Furjan, this development brings together five residential buildings and a dedicated office tower, all connected through a shared podium featuring retail outlets, wellness spaces, and premium leisure facilities. Al Furjan has steadily grown into one of Dubai's most desirable residential communities, and Richmond District sits comfortably at its centre. Richmond District delivers a well-rounded set of amenities that support both active and relaxed lifestyles without residents needing to step outside the community. The facilities are designed to complement the development's design identity while serving everyday needs.

The design language of Richmond District is derived directly from the John Richmond fashion house a brand known for its ability to fuse edge with elegance. The architecture avoids the generic glass-and-steel formula that dominates so much of Dubai's newer stock, opting instead for a more considered visual identity that feels both contemporary and distinctive. Inside the residences, the fully furnished interiors reflect this sensibility through quality materials, carefully selected furniture pieces, and design details that carry a clear aesthetic point of view.

projects.name: Stories
description: Stories by Mirfa IBC Developers is a thoughtfully crafted residential development located in Dubai South, one of the emirate's most strategically positioned and rapidly growing communities. Offering studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments across six elegantly designed floors, Stories presents 100 carefully planned homes that blend comfort, natural light, and contemporary aesthetics into a seamless living experience.

Every residence within Stories is designed around the philosophy that a home should feel expansive, warm, and effortlessly livable. Open-plan layouts allow natural light to flow freely through each unit, creating bright and airy interiors that feel larger than their dimensions suggest. Premium quality materials, neutral tones, and textured finishes come together to deliver a refined atmosphere that suits both singles and growing families.

Dubai South, also known as Dubai World Central, is one of the most ambitious urban developments in the region. Designed as a fully integrated city, it spans 145 square kilometres and sits at the heart of Dubai's future economic and residential expansion. The area is home to Al Maktoum International Airport, the upcoming Dubai Exhibition Centre, and a growing network of residential, commercial, and logistics zones that make it an ideal address for professionals, investors, and families alike.
